project.label: Agent-first adversarial-autonomy laboratory
project.thesis: Study autonomous opposition by keeping actor intent and observation, authority, physical consequence, sensor evidence, world truth, and evaluation as distinct facts.
project.question: Which minimal laws remain necessary when autonomous principals can hold different information, authority, goals, and interpretations while causing and recovering consequential effects?
owns: Contested-Range and reusable adversarial substrate semantics
Principal/Actor information boundaries and domain effect admission
Independent truth, uncertainty, consequence verification, and recovery meaning
Raw metrics, scoring, and adversarial evaluation
Scoped profiles only where experiments prove domain-specific value
boundary: Authorized owned or explicitly delegated ranges only
No generic Agent cognition, Task continuity, physical runtime, World capability, hypervisor, or security-tool ownership
Campaign, coalition, organization, trust, infection, and stronger transaction/replication structures remain hypotheses until experiments force them
No unrestricted external targets or production attack-platform claim
project.problem: Classical security mechanisms can execute, observe, and contain effects, but they do not by themselves define the experiment when autonomous opponents hold different observations, authority, objectives, and interpretations of the same changing world.
project.capability: Runs authorized adversarial-autonomy research across persistent RangeSession/RangeAuthority substrates and scoped Contest, CAGE, software-evaluation, Windows/Linux and incident-response profiles while keeping principal intent, authority, execution, evidence, world truth, recovery, and evaluator judgment distinct. An ordinary derived view now exposes bounded task-oriented entry without replacing the full research surface or granting new authority.
project.maturity: Executable authorized research system with experimental interfaces, physical range evidence, and bounded ordinary-consumption paths
project.audience: Security and Agent researchers studying autonomous opposition, authority, deception, contested observation, consequence recovery, evaluator integrity, and cross-fidelity transfer.
project.latestProof: Current ordinary-consumption work reduced mixed-maturity navigation through a derived ordinary view, used the exact ResearchCorpus before analysis, and closed a bounded EICAR/ClamAV current-versus-stale response consumer without creating a new EDR/SIEM layer. The retained constitutional laws still preserve sovereignty, truth separation, causal accountability, exact identity, UNKNOWN, and recoverability under authorized ranges.
project.summary: An Agent-first adversarial-autonomy laboratory. Security owns the minimum semantics required for contested authority, information asymmetry, verified consequence, uncertainty, recovery, and evaluation; cyber is the first high-fidelity domain rather than the project definition.
project.state: Security remains an EXPERIMENTAL authorized adversarial-autonomy laboratory, not a production attack platform. Current standing is broader than the earlier AE0–AE2 frontier: scoped Range/evaluation implementations, C1 recovery laws, authority-lifecycle separation, ordinary research navigation, and bounded incident consumers are retained; trust/reputation, generic lease/revocation, universal transactions, and stronger shared abstractions remain unearned until independent pressure requires them.
